summary.caption: Epic dark-fantasy action game cover, volcanic cathedral ruins beneath a black-red eclipse, two opponents locked in a diagonal confrontation, airborne ash, molten gold highlights, deep charcoal shadows and premium painterly key-art finish.

items.label: character
items.caption: Lower-left foreground: battle-worn female knight in blackened silver armour, torn crimson cape and glowing sun-sword raised toward the enemy, dynamic full-body three-quarter pose.

items.label: character
items.caption: Upper-right: towering antlered ash king in fractured obsidian armour, enormous silhouette descending through smoke with a molten spear, menacing full figure.

items.label: object
items.caption: A blazing black-red eclipse ring at the upper centre, showering sparks through the ruined cathedral and visually separating the opponents.

items.label: text
items.caption: Huge weathered ivory fantasy game title stacked across the lower centre.

items.label: text
items.caption: Tiny gold uppercase release line at the bottom.
